items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S8337

SPONSOR: GOLDEN
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend Part AAA of chapter 59 of the laws of
2017, amending the vehicle and traffic law and other laws relating to
the regulation of transportation network company services, in relation
to the effectiveness thereof

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

This bill extends section 26 of Part AAA of chapter 59 of the laws of
2017 to extend the regulation of transportation network company
services.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section one of the bill amends Part AAA of chapter 59 of the laws of
2017 to extend the regulation of transportation network company services
for a further two years.

Section two provides that this act shall take effect immediately.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Currently section 26 of Part AAA of chapter 59 of the laws of 2017 is
set to sunset this year. This bill extends the study of transportation
network companies (TNCs) for a further two years.  TNCs, or ridesharing,
use digital platforms to match consumers with vetted local drivers with
the use of their own personal vehicle.  These companies provide a number
of benefits to New Yorkers including curbed traffic congestion, reduced
air pollution, lower drunk driving rates, and affordable transportation.
Under the current statute, drivers are eligible for workers compensation
when they are active on their mobile app and an accident occurs. By
extending this study, New York State will better understand the needs of
drivers.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Relates to the effectiveness of certain provisions of law relating to the regulation of transportation network company services.
